guide.title: How to use Today Ad Trend
guide.subtitle: Your 3-minute ad briefing, explained
guide.introDesc: Today Ad Trend is a daily advertising briefing you can actually finish. Every day you get 5 to 7 stories picked for your role, each with a short “so what” that explains what it means for your work. Read them and you're done for the day.
guide.highlightSoWhatShort: What each story means for you
guide.gettingStartedDesc: Setup takes less than a minute, and you don't need an account.
guide.downloadAppDesc: Search for “Today Ad Trend” on the App Store or Google Play.
guide.chooseRoleDesc: Pick Performance, UA / App or Brand & creative. You can change it any time in Settings.
guide.setTimeDesc: Choose when you want your reminder (08:00 by default) and allow notifications.
guide.todayDesc: The Today tab shows the edition for your role: the date, a one-line headline and 5 to 7 stories.
guide.readSummaryDesc: Each story has a short summary in our own words and a link to the original article.
guide.checkSoWhatDesc: The highlighted line explains what the story means for your role and what you might do about it.
guide.finishDesc: Opening a story marks it as read. Read them all to see “You're done for today” and keep your streak going.
guide.rolesDesc: Every story is scored for each role, so the three editions pick different stories and explain them differently.
guide.roleUaFocus: App stores, SKAdNetwork, mobile measurement and install costs
guide.roleBrandFocus: Formats, video, reach and creative direction
guide.exploreDesc: Want more than the brief? The Explore tab has everything from the last two weeks.
guide.explorePlatformsShort: Official updates from Meta, Google, Apple and more
guide.savedDesc: Tap save on any story to keep it in your swipe file. Add brands, platforms or topics to your watchlist and matching stories get a badge.
guide.savedTip: Everything you save stays on your device. There is no account and nothing to sync.
guide.pulseDesc: Creative Pulse samples the public Google Ads Transparency Center dataset every week. It estimates the share of new creatives by format and audience approach, lists the advertisers launching the most new creatives and highlights long-running ads.
guide.pulseNote: The numbers are estimates from a random sample, not a full count, and they only cover ads shown in the EEA and Turkey.
guide.whenPublishedA: A new edition is ready every day by about 21:00 UTC. That's the next morning in Asia and Europe and the evening before in the Americas.
guide.noReminderA: Check that notifications are allowed for Today Ad Trend in your device settings and that the reminder is on in the app's Settings. Reminders are scheduled on your device.
guide.sourcesQ: Where does the content come from?
guide.sourcesA: From public feeds of trade publications, official platform blogs and expert newsletters. Summaries and “so what” lines are written by AI, and every story links to the original.
guide.changeRoleQ: How do I change my role?
guide.changeRoleA: Open Settings and choose another role. Your next brief uses the new edition.
guide.freeA: Yes. The app is free and shows a small number of ads outside the daily brief.
